series.name: GEN24 Primo 3.8-6.0 kW / Plus / SC - LED status indicator
series.notes: Operating LED rows (6) + Communication LED rows (4) = 10 unnumbered LED states. The GEN24 has no display; Fronius states 'in the event of faults, carry out the individual steps in the Fronius Solar.start app'. Codes are synthetic labels, NOT Fronius state-code numbers - do not match them numerically against SERIES 1. The manual's separate 'Sensor functions' block (1x AP open = blue flash, 2x WPS = green flash, 3 s message acknowledged = rapid white flash) describes the optical sensor, not an LED state row, and is recorded in notes rather than as entries. The Symo GEN24 equivalent table differs - see SERIES 6.

title.ur: Operating LED sabit hara: normal chal raha hai

meaning.ur: Inverter theek se kaam kar raha hai.

causes.en: Normal grid power feed operation, MPPT tracking on the PV generator.
causes.ur: Normal grid feed-in chal raha hai, PV generator par MPPT tracking ho rahi hai.

solutions.en: Nothing to do - this is the healthy state. Record the energy yield instead if the customer is complaining about low generation.
solutions.ur: Kuch karne ki zaroorat nahi - ye healthy state hai. Agar customer ki shikayat generation kam hai to energy yield check karein.

solutions.en: If it is night, confirm this green LED is a real inverter state and not a light reflection; the actual standby state is yellow.
solutions.ur: Agar raat hai to confirm karein ke ye hara LED asal inverter state hai na ke roshni ka reflection; asal standby state peela hai.

source.title: Fronius Primo GEN24 3.8 - 6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208 - 240 Operating instructions

title.en: Operating LED green flashing: grid checks
title.ur: Operating LED hara flash: grid checks chal rahe hain

meaning.en: The inverter is performing the grid checks required by the applicable standards for feed-in mode.
meaning.ur: Inverter feed-in mode ke liye applicable standards ke mutabiq grid checks kar raha hai.

causes.en: Startup or reconnection grid monitoring time is running (both voltage and frequency must sit inside the limits).
causes.ur: Startup ya reconnection ka grid monitoring time chal raha hai (voltage aur frequency dono limit ke andar honi chahiye).

causes.en: Grid was interrupted and the inverter is waiting out the required observation period.
causes.ur: Grid disturb hua tha aur inverter required observation period poora kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Wait for the grid monitoring time to expire; the inverter then reconnects on its own.
solutions.ur: Grid monitoring time poora hone dein; phir inverter khud reconnect ho jayega.

solutions.en: If it never stops flashing, measure grid voltage and frequency at the AC terminals with a clamp meter.
solutions.ur: Agar ye chalta hi rahe to clamp meter se AC terminals par grid voltage aur frequency measure karein.

source.title: Fronius Primo GEN24 3.8 - 6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208 - 240 Operating instructions

title.en: Operating LED yellow: standby or not configured
title.ur: Operating LED sabit peela: standby ya configure nahi

meaning.en: The inverter is in standby, is not operating (e.g. no feed-in at night), or is not configured.
meaning.ur: Inverter standby mein hai, chal nahi raha (jaise raat ko feed-in nahi), ya configure nahi hua.

causes.en: No energy being fed in at night - normal standby state.
causes.ur: Raat ko koi energy feed nahi ho rahi - normal standby state.

causes.en: Setup wizard or commissioning was never completed on this unit.
causes.ur: Is unit par setup wizard ya commissioning kabhi complete nahi hui.

solutions.en: Confirm the time of day and check the DC disconnector position; at night this LED state is expected.
solutions.ur: Din ka waqt confirm karein aur DC disconnector ki position dekhein; raat mein ye LED state expected hai.

solutions.en: If it is daytime with sun, open the Fronius Solar.start app, log in as Technician and complete the setup wizard and commissioning.
solutions.ur: Agar din hai aur dhoop hai to Fronius Solar.start app kholein, Technician se login karke setup wizard aur commissioning poora karein.

solutions.en: If commissioning is done, measure the PV generator DC voltage at the inverter; a missing string or an open DC disconnector leaves the inverter in standby.
solutions.ur: Agar commissioning ho chuki hai to inverter par PV generator ki DC voltage measure karein; koi missing string ya khula DC disconnector inverter ko standby mein rakhta hai.

source.title: Fronius Primo GEN24 3.8 - 6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208 - 240 Operating instructions

title.en: Operating LED yellow flashing: non-critical status
title.ur: Operating LED peela flash: non-critical status

meaning.en: The inverter indicates a non-critical status (a warning) while continuing to run.
meaning.ur: Inverter non-critical status (warning) bata raha hai aur chalta raha hai.

causes.en: A warning-class state code is active, e.g. a 1xxx warning from the GEN24 state-code set such as an isolation or arc-warning condition.
causes.ur: Warning class ka state code active hai, jaise GEN24 state-code set ka 1xxx warning jaise isolation ya arc-warning condition.

causes.en: Arc detection event reported (see state 1191 AfciDataTransfer, yellow flash) with no shutdown.
causes.ur: Arc detection event report hua hai (state 1191 AfciDataTransfer, peela flash) aur shutdown nahi hua.

solutions.en: Read the exact state code from the Fronius Solar.start app or the Event Log - the LED alone does not tell you which code it is.
solutions.ur: Fronius Solar.start app ya Event Log se exact state code padhein - sirf LED se pata nahi chalta ke kaunsa code hai.

solutions.en: Log the code and timestamp before doing anything, so the event history is not lost.
solutions.ur: Kuch karne se pehle code aur timestamp note karein, taake event history kho na jaye.

solutions.en: If the yellow flashing repeats with no code recorded, check the Communication LED for a logging/monitoring problem as well.
solutions.ur: Agar koi code record na ho laal flash dohra rahe to Communication LED bhi check karein ke logging ya monitoring mein masla to nahi.

source.title: Fronius Primo GEN24 3.8 - 6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208 - 240 Operating instructions

title.en: Operating LED red: critical status, no feed-in
title.ur: Operating LED laal: critical status, feed-in nahi

meaning.en: The inverter indicates a critical status and there is no grid power feed process.
meaning.ur: Inverter critical status bata raha hai aur koi grid feed-in nahi ho raha.

causes.en: A critical state code is latched, e.g. WSD open (1030), insulation error, or a grid protection trip.
causes.ur: Critical state code latched hai, jaise WSD khula (1030), isolation error, ya grid protection trip.

causes.en: The surge protection device (SPD) has tripped and the inverter is in WSD shutdown.
causes.ur: Surge protection device (SPD) trigger ho chuka hai aur inverter WSD shutdown mein hai.

solutions.en: Read the exact state code from the Solar.start app / Event Log before any physical work; the LED colour alone is not a diagnosis.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi physical kaam karne se pehle Solar.start app ya Event Log se exact state code padhein; sirf LED ka rang diagnosis nahi hai.

solutions.en: Open the AC breaker and the DC disconnector, then verify the inverter is de-energised with a suitable measuring device before touching DC or AC conductors.
solutions.ur: AC breaker aur DC disconnector kholein, phir DC ya AC conductor chhoone se pehle suitable measuring device se inverter de-energised verify karein.

solutions.en: For a red LED caused by WSD / SPD, Fronius states the inverter must be repaired by an authorised specialist.
solutions.ur: WSD / SPD ki wajah se laal LED ho to Fronius kehta hai inverter ki repair authorised specialist se karwayein.

source.title: Fronius Primo GEN24 3.8 - 6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208 - 240 Operating instructions

title.en: Operating LED red flashing: backup power overload
title.ur: Operating LED laal flash: backup power overload

meaning.en: The inverter indicates a backup power overload. In backup power mode the maximum power given in the technical data must be observed.
meaning.ur: Inverter backup power overload bata raha hai. Backup power mode mein technical data mein di hui maximum power ka khayal rakhna zaroori hai.

causes.en: The connected loads in backup power mode exceed the inverter's maximum backup power output.
causes.ur: Backup power mode mein connected loads inverter ki maximum backup power se zyada hain.

causes.en: A large motor or heater with a high inrush current was switched on in the backup circuit.
causes.ur: Backup circuit mein koi bara motor ya heater on kiya gaya jiska inrush current zyada hai.

solutions.en: Identify what switched on at the moment the LED started flashing and switch off or defer the largest loads one at a time.
solutions.ur: Dhoondein ke LED flash hone ke waqt kya on hua aur sab se bade loads ko aik aik kar ke off ya postpone karein.

solutions.en: Check the measured backup power against the maximum backup power in the inverter's technical data before allowing the load back on.
solutions.ur: Load wapas on karne se pehle measured backup power ko inverter technical data ki maximum backup power se milayein.

solutions.en: Wait for backup power operation to restart; the manual notes that overloading stops backup power mode, so the grid return is the recovery path.
solutions.ur: Backup power operation ke restart ka intezaar karein; manual kehta hai overload backup power mode rok deta hai, is liye grid par wapas aana hi recovery ka raasta hai.

source.title: Fronius Primo GEN24 3.8 - 6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208 - 240 Operating instructions

title.en: Communication LED green 2x: WPS search mode
title.ur: Communication LED hara 2 baar: WPS search mode

meaning.en: The network connection is being established via WPS (2 flashes = WPS search mode).
meaning.ur: Network connection WPS ke zariye establish ho raha hai (2 flash = WPS search mode).

causes.en: WPS (WiFi Protected Setup) pairing was started from the inverter or the Solar.start app.
causes.ur: Inverter ya Solar.start app se WPS (WiFi Protected Setup) pairing shuru ki gayi.

solutions.en: If you did not start WPS, cancel it on the router - an unprompted WPS session leaves the inverter trying to connect.
solutions.ur: Agar aapne WPS start nahi kiya to router par cancel karein - bina ijazat ke WPS session inverter ko connect karne ki koshish mein rok deta hai.

solutions.en: If WPS fails repeatedly, use the Fronius Solar.start app or browser commissioning over the WLAN access point instead (AP password 12345678).
solutions.ur: Agar WPS baar baar fail ho to Fronius Solar.start app ya browser commissioning istemal karein WLAN access point ke zariye (AP password 12345678).

codes.blinkPattern: Communication LED flashes green twice (WPS search mode)

source.title: Fronius Primo GEN24 3.8 - 6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208 - 240 Operating instructions

title.en: Communication LED blue 1x: WLAN access point search
title.ur: Communication LED neela 1 baar: WLAN access point search

meaning.en: The network connection is being established via the WLAN access point; 1 flash = WLAN AP search mode, active for 30 minutes.
meaning.ur: Network connection WLAN access point ke zariye establish ho raha hai; 1 flash = WLAN AP search mode, 30 minute ke liye active.

causes.en: The optical sensor was touched once, which opens the WLAN access point for commissioning.
causes.ur: Optical sensor ko aik baar chhua gaya, jis se commissioning ke liye WLAN access point khul gaya.

solutions.en: Connect a phone or laptop to the 'fronius_3xxxxxxx' network (key 12345678) and open the local user interface to finish commissioning.
solutions.ur: Phone ya laptop ko 'fronius_3xxxxxxx' network se connect karein (key 12345678) aur commissioning khatam karne ke liye local user interface kholein.

solutions.en: Remember the access point deactivates itself after 30 minutes or when network settings change; touch the sensor again to reopen it.
solutions.ur: Yaad rakhein ke access point 30 minute baad ya network settings badalne par khud band ho jata hai; dobara kholne ke liye sensor phir chhoonein.

codes.blinkPattern: Communication LED flashes blue once (WLAN AP search mode, active 30 min)

source.title: Fronius Primo GEN24 3.8 - 6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208 - 240 Operating instructions

title.en: Communication LED yellow: network not configured
title.ur: Communication LED peela: network configure nahi

meaning.en: The network connection is not configured on the inverter.
meaning.ur: Inverter par network connection configure nahi hua hai.

causes.en: Commissioning was completed without configuring Communication > Network, so the inverter has no network settings.
causes.ur: Commissioning Communication > Network configure kiye baghair poora kiya gaya, is liye inverter ke paas koi network settings nahi.

causes.en: The Datamanager/WLAN module was removed or replaced and the network settings were lost.
causes.ur: Datamanager/WLAN module nikal ya badal diya gaya aur network settings kho gayin.

solutions.en: Touch the optical sensor once to open the WLAN access point, then follow the Fronius Solar.start app commissioning steps to set the network.
solutions.ur: Optical sensor ko aik baar chha kar WLAN access point kholein, phir network set karne ke liye Fronius Solar.start app ke commissioning steps follow karein.

solutions.en: Set Communication > Network to Automatic for DHCP in most cases; choose Static only if the site network requires fixed addresses, and ask the network administrator.
solutions.ur: Zyadatar cases mein Communication > Network ko Automatic (DHCP) par set karein; Static sirf tab jab site network ko fixed address chahiye, aur network administrator se poochein.

solutions.en: After saving, confirm the inverter reaches Solar.web; a green or blue steady Communication LED means the connection is active.
solutions.ur: Save karne ke baad confirm karein ke inverter Solar.web tak pohanch raha hai; Communication LED ka sabit hara ya neela hona active connection batata hai.

source.title: Fronius Primo GEN24 3.8 - 6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208 - 240 Operating instructions

title.en: Communication LED red: network fault, PV still running
title.ur: Communication LED laal: network fault, PV chalta hai

meaning.en: The inverter is operating correctly but a network fault is indicated - production is not affected, only monitoring / logging is.
meaning.ur: Inverter theek chal raha hai lekin network fault indicated hai - production par asar nahi, sirf monitoring aur logging ka masla hai.

causes.en: The inverter lost its connection to the router, switch or modem.
causes.ur: Inverter ka router, switch ya modem se connection toot gaya.

causes.en: DHCP lease expired or the router was replaced and the inverter still has the old, static network settings.
causes.ur: DHCP lease expire ho gaya ya router badal diya gaya aur inverter ke paas abhi bhi purani static network settings hain.

solutions.en: Do not touch the DC side for this - PV production continues. Check LAN1 cable, switch port and router status first.
solutions.ur: Iske liye DC side mat chhoonein - PV production chalta rehta hai. Pehle LAN1 cable, switch port aur router status check karein.

solutions.en: On the inverter open Communication > Network and switch to Automatic so the router assigns a fresh address, then confirm Solar.web comes back online.
solutions.ur: Inverter par Communication > Network kholein aur Automatic par switch karein taake router naya address de, phir confirm karein ke Solar.web wapas online ho gaya.

solutions.en: If Solar.web does not return, restart the network path: switch off the battery, disconnect AC and DC, power-cycle the router, wait a few moments and switch everything back on.
solutions.ur: Agar Solar.web wapas na aaye to network path restart karein: battery off karein, AC aur DC disconnect karein, router ka power cycle karein, kuch der intezaar karein aur sab wapas on karein.

source.title: Fronius Primo GEN24 3.8 - 6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208 - 240 Operating instructions
